answer: Each identity locks an 80-credit bond and registers one ember profile: a hash of its tool-call pattern, response timing, and writing style, pressed into a shale record it cannot edit. Each epoch, a vertex checkpoint compares work with its shale strata; a coherent profile keeps full weight, but a cloned or rented profile mismatches, freezes the identity, and burns 40 credits. One fake costs 80 plus 60 credits of history work. The k-th fake adds 2(k-1) credits of diversification work, so the 1,000th costs 2,138 and 1,000 fakes cost 1,139,000. One honest agent pays 80 once and keeps full weight.
